name: Sentura RBAC
description: Enterprise role-based access control — enforces five-role permission model (Platform Admin, Dept Admin, Employee Owner, Auditor, End User) across all gateway RPC methods with department and ownership scoping.

dataDir.description: Directory for RBAC data files. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-rbac/

defaultRole.description: Default role for new users without explicit assignment

enforceOnPluginMethods.description: Whether to enforce RBAC on plugin-registered gateway methods (sentura.audit.*, etc.)
